integrity.finite_checks: Independent graph-distance enumeration, all vertex subsets for n=2..8, exact coefficient arithmetic for n=2..150
integrity.proof_basis: unique full-column geodesic representation, disjoint-matching bijection and complementary geodesic-free-set classification

scientific_limitations: Finite simple unweighted graphs K_2 Cartesian K_n, n>=2 only. Unordered vertex-disjoint maximal paths considered up to reversal. Strict log-concavity is proved, not real-rootedness. No generalization to larger rook graphs or absolute priority claim.
title: Complete geodesic-packing and transversal polynomials of two-row rook graphs
